svg.title: System and request flow
svg.desc: The requester mentions a dedicated Bot from their own chat account on a phone or browser. Chat Agent Bridge on the local PC checks allowed users and passes the request to Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI, which must be installed separately. The CLI runs the AI agent with credentials configured on the PC, and the Bot returns the result in the same thread.
